-# Pin the workspace Rust toolchain so contract wasm bytecode is reproducible:
-# `stable` drifts across releases and can change optimizer/codegen output for
-# byte-identical source. Bump this deliberately (and re-record deployed wasm
-# hashes in DEPLOYED.md) rather than letting it float. CI pins the same version
-# in .github/workflows/test.yml -- keep the two in lockstep.
-#
-# NOTE: confirm this matches the toolchain that built the currently-deployed
-# contracts before treating any rebuild as byte-for-byte reproducible.
-[toolchain]
-channel = "1.96.0"
-targets = ["wasm32v1-none"]
